name: windmill-hr
description: Connect Cursor to Windmill for performance reviews, feedback, 1:1s, pulse surveys, and more.

skills.name: collect-feedback
skills.description: Context and guidance for collecting user-initiated feedback about colleagues. Use when user wants to give feedback to a coworker.

skills.name: create-pulse
skills.description: Context and guidance for creating pulse surveys. Use when user wants to create a new pulse, gather feedback or sentiment from their team, or asks to "ask the team" about something.

skills.name: manage-1on1s
skills.description: Context and guidance for managing 1:1 agendas, preparation, notes, action items, and history. Use when users want to create standalone or calendar-linked 1:1 records, import historical notes through the in-platform flow, work with images in 1:1 notes, append/edit/replace shared 1

skills.name: manage-notes
skills.description: Context and guidance for managing private notes for the current employee. Use when users want to create, retrieve, update, or delete personal notes about colleagues.

skills.name: manage-pulse
skills.description: Context and guidance for managing existing pulses. Use when users want to pause, resume, send now, schedule, send nudges, update participants, or check on pulse results.
